text: Flash flood across Padinjarathara-Panamaram link road near reservoir canal.
Estate workers stranded near Meppadi stream crossing after heavy rainfall.
Forest route causeway inundated with 0.3m water near Noolpuzha.
Panamaram River breached bank. Causeway flooded under 0.8m water.
45 residents stranded near Mananthavady low-lying bus stand. NDRF deployed.
Runoff water accumulating near agricultural research station; culvert partially choked.
